name: Per (Sir Per)
description: The youngest son, poor and ragged at first, who becomes “Sir Per” through the cat’s schemes and ends up ruling a realm.
visualPrompt: A young Nordic folktale hero with kind eyes and a humble face; first in simple worn travel clothes, later in astonishingly rich garments with subtle gold accents, standing uncertain but brave

name: The Cat / Enchanted Princess
description: A sharp-tongued, fearless cat who coerces forest animals into becoming royal gifts and later transforms into a princess freed from a troll’s enchantment.
visualPrompt: A sleek gray cat with intelligent, commanding eyes and an alert posture, sometimes perched between the antlers of a great stag or moose; hint of hidden royal elegance in her bearing

name: The King
description: A proud ruler delighted by lavish gifts, then irritated by Per’s boasting, who follows him to see the supposed splendor for himself.
visualPrompt: A middle-aged king in rich robes and a fur-trimmed cloak, wearing a gold crown and an expression shifting between pleasure, suspicion, and pride; attended by a small retinue

name: The Troll of the Castle
description: The monstrous owner of the shining castle, undone when the cat tricks him into turning toward the rising sun.
visualPrompt: A huge, rough-skinned troll with heavy features and wild hair, looming at a grand gate with clenched fists, radiating menace; faint cracks of light gathering as sunrise nears
